title: quercus calliprinos var. recurvans
intro: Quercus calliprinos var. recurvans, commonly known as Cypriot oak, is a variety of evergreen tree that is native to the island of Cyprus and other parts of the Eastern Mediterranean. The health benefits of Quercus calliprinos var. recurvans include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Quercus calliprinos var. recurvans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
